name: Baglioni Hotel Regina
insider_take: This historic palace turned luxury hotel sits on Rome's legendary Via Veneto, where Fellini filmed La Dolce Vita and celebrities once strolled during the glamorous 1960s.
whats_special: The Baglioni Hotel Regina occupies a Belle Époque palace from 1894, featuring original Roman Empire artifacts in its foundation and a rooftop terrace with panoramic views of Villa Borghese. Its position on Via Veneto places you at the heart of Rome's former Hollywood, just steps from the Spanish Steps and Trevi Fountain.
pro_tip: Book a table at the hotel's rooftop restaurant during sunset – you'll enjoy unobstructed views of St. Peter's Dome while dining on contemporary Italian cuisine.
dont_miss: Take an evening passeggiata down Via Veneto to Café de Paris, the legendary café where paparazzi coined their name, then walk to the nearby Capuchin Crypt with its haunting bone decorations – a hidden Roman treasure just 5 minutes away.
pros: Prime location on Via Veneto near Spanish Steps and Trevi Fountain
Elegant Belle Époque architecture with luxurious Italian design
Exceptional personalized service and concierge expertise
Award-winning Brunello Bar & Restaurant with rooftop terrace
cons: Historic building with traditional room layouts
